newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Power to auction T$7 bln bonds on Oct 28.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Power to auction T$7 bln bonds on Oct 28.

text.p: State-run utility Taiwan Power Co said on Friday it would auction T$7 billion in seven-year unsecured corporate bonds on October 28 to raise funds for power source development.
"We will formally issue the T$7 billion bonds in December. The coupon rate will be set after the October 28 auction," Taipower finance director Liu Chang-ming told Reuters.
"The funds will be used to finance our development of power sources," Liu said by telephone.
The local Economic Daily News on Friday estimated the bond's auction rate would be lower than 6.5 percent.
"I cannot comment on the report, but I hope the rate is even lower (than 6.5 percent)," Liu said.
